subject: geography
title: Environmental Threats: Foundations

concepts.def: Harmful substances released into air, water or land.
Includes smog, NOx and PM2.5 from fossil fuels and vehicles.
Plastics, sewage and fertiliser run-off harming aquatic life.
Waste from landfill, mining and fly-tipping.
Long-term warming driven mostly by greenhouse gas emissions.
Falling number of species due to habitat loss and pollution. 🌫

walkthroughs.body_html:
Pollution comes in three flavours.

Air like smog, water like sewage and land like landfill.

Each harms ecosystems and human health.

Climate change is the biggest long-term threat.

Driven mainly by burning fossil fuels and deforestation.

Global mean temperature has risen ~1.2 degrees C since 1900.

Biodiversity is declining.

WWF reports global wildlife populations have fallen by around 69% since 1970.

Habitat loss is the leading driver.

Fertiliser run-off
Landfill leachate only
Light pollution

mcqs.q: What is the main driver of recent climate change?
options: Solar flares
Greenhouse gas emissions
Volcanic activity
Earth's orbit

mcqs.q: What is the difference between weather and climate?
options: Anticyclones bring heavy rainfall because they trap moisture.
Weather happens outside and climate happens globally.
Weather refers to rain and climate refers to temperature.
Weather is short-term atmospheric conditions at a specific time and place; climate is the long-term (typically 30-year) average of weather patterns in a region.

mcqs.q: What is the enhanced greenhouse effect?
options: Weather refers to rain and climate refers to temperature.
It is the hole in the ozone layer letting in more sun.
The greenhouse effect is entirely man-made and harmful.
The strengthening of the natural greenhouse effect by human activities (mainly burning fossil fuels) which add CO2 and other gases to the atmosphere.

mcqs.q: What weather does an anticyclone (high pressure system) bring?
options: Descending air warms and dries, suppressing cloud formation — so anticyclones bring clear, settled weather: hot in summer, cold and frosty in winter.
High pressure brings stormy weather because the air pushes down hard.
It is the hole in the ozone layer letting in more sun.
Anticyclones bring heavy rainfall because they trap moisture.
